native_server_message_acl_paths: modules/message/api_message_get.go (channelMessagesSync, searchUserMessages): evaluates current group/thread membership, group/thread status and space_id, message deletion/expiry, message_extra revoke/delete/edit, payload visibles whitelist, per-user message_user_extra deletion, per-user channel_offset (which records both user clear-history and allow_view_history_msg=0 join-time history cutoffs via modules/message/event.go:handleGroupMemberAddEvent), and channel-wide channel_setting.offset_message_seq.

pkg/permissionbundle/server_message_facts.go (ServerMessageFactProvider.resolveOne, ListHistoryHeadersV1, IssueHistoryDisclosureV1, BindDeliveredMessageV1): evaluates the exact same native current group/thread/DM ACL over octo-server SQL tables under the caller's RepeatableRead transaction.

pkg/permissionbundle/native_facts_adapter.go (SQLNativeFactAdapter.readResolve, readHistoryHeaders, readHistoryDisclosure, BindDeliveredMessage): combines locking SQL principal/space/group/thread/relation predicates with ServerMessageFactProvider facts.
product_semantics_and_native_acl_trace.root_cause_before_correction: In d1cda266944af459fd92db3602f3a054fd31c0c7, ServerMessageFactProvider.resolveOne (pkg/permissionbundle/server_message_facts.go:547-559) set CallerOriginalVisibleUnknown=true and BotOriginalVisibleUnknown=true for all group (channel_type=2) and thread (channel_type=5) messages whenever payload visibles did not exclude the principal. As a result: (1) BindDeliveredMessageV1 emitted unknown_predicates=['bot_original_visible','caller_original_visible'] and resolvable_purposes=['reply'], causing Agent prepareInput to fail closed with PERMISSION_NATIVE_ORIGINAL_VISIBILITY_UNKNOWN; (2) InspectDeliveredHeadersV1 / SQLNativeFactAdapter.readResolve returned status='unavailable', reason='predicate_unsupported' for purpose='admit' and 'contributor'; and (3) IssueHistoryDisclosureV1 returned status='unavailable', reason='disclosure_unavailable' for group/thread headers.
correction: In ServerMessageFactProvider.resolveOne (pkg/permissionbundle/server_message_facts.go), group and thread channels now derive d.CallerOriginalVisible = d.CallerCurrentRead and d.BotOriginalVisible = d.BotCurrentRead from the complete native current read ACL (activeMember && PayloadVisibleTo(msg.payload) && (!extra.edit.Valid || PayloadVisibleTo(editedBody)) && !userHidden) without setting CallerOriginalVisibleUnknown or BotOriginalVisibleUnknown.

In ServerMessageFactProvider.BindDeliveredMessageV1 (pkg/permissionbundle/server_message_facts.go), visibility_denied is enforced when (!d.MessageSpaceUnknown && !d.MessageSpaceExact) || !d.BotCurrentRead || !d.CallerCurrentRead || !d.MessageRecipientExact, and resolvable_purposes=['admit','contributor','reply'] requires d.CallerOriginalVisible && d.BotOriginalVisible with zero original-visibility unknowns.

In ServerMessageFactProvider.IssueHistoryDisclosureV1 (pkg/permissionbundle/server_message_facts.go), permit issuance requires !d.CallerOriginalVisibleUnknown && !d.BotOriginalVisibleUnknown && d.CallerCurrentRead && d.CallerOriginalVisible && d.BotCurrentRead && d.BotOriginalVisible in addition to exact space, source, and native message version.

receive_before_persistence_timing_bounda.reproduction_and_finding: In live WukongIM + octo-server deployments, WukongIM pushes WKSocket RECV frames to connected Agents in ~2-5ms while batching msg.notify gRPC webhook persistence calls to octo-server (Webhook.handleMessageNotify -> message{N} table insert) by msgNotifyEventPushInterval (default 500ms). When an Agent invokes POST /v1/bot/permission-facts/v1/bind-delivery before Webhook.handleMessageNotify commits the message row in MySQL, loadMessage observes sql.ErrNoRows and returns status='refused', reason='mirror_lag', current=false. Once the webhook persists the row, the identical bind_delivery and resolve(admit) calls immediately return status='bound' and status='resolved'.
receive_before_persistence_timing_bounda.server_boundary_decision: Returning status='refused', reason='mirror_lag' for unpersisted rows is the mandatory fail-closed Server contract (octo-server must never infer authority from an unpersisted transport frame before message persistence). No server-side sleep or unpersisted-frame bypass was introduced; the pre-persistence (mirror_lag) to post-persistence (bound) transition is covered in TestServerMessageFactsNativeCurrentACLGroupAndThreadAdmissionAndPreJoinHistory.
